chapter: The band, its players and singers
title: Boogie-woogie piano
summary: Basie says he tried some boogie-woogie, heard in Kansas City, and names Pete Johnson, Albert Ammons and Meade Lux Lewis.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I see. That's nice. Okay. All right. How about boogie-woogie piano. Did you ever go for that.
I tried to do a couple of things with it, which is something that I heard a lot of in Kansas City and then I heard a couple of the top guys playing it, who really could play it.

Well, Pete Deke Johnson and Albert Ammons, 'Luxe' Lewis and Luck Liz and (inaudible) -- he played "Honky Tonk Train," what's his name, can't think of the name of it, but I think he would be mentioned in there, because he's made "Honky Tonk Train." (inaudible).
